reason: No concrete, codable long-side rules for US stocks; relies on discretionary pattern recognition, adaptability, and sentiment awareness.
style: discretionary swing/position trading with pattern recognition

universe.description: US stocks in bull market trends

setup.rule: Stock in bull market trend pulls back ~50%, consolidates, then shows large magnitude moves breaking the range
setup.quote: you'll see a stock that's in a bull market Trend and it'll pull back to a reasonable maybe a 50% pullback and consolidate and consolidate and consolidate and kind of lull people to sleep and then something will a a headline will come out or maybe not a headline but there will be a series of large magnitude moves that I'm very good at monitoring with my proprietary screen setup and that causes me to sit up in my chair

setup.rule: Buy pullbacks to trendline or moving average support (30/50/100/200-day) in bull market names
setup.quote: watching things pull back into trend line support that I can draw or moving average support that gets drawn for me 30 uh 50-day moving average 100 day moving average 200 day moving averages

entry.rule: Enter long on breakout of consolidation/range after pullback in bull trend
entry.quote: just broke the range and that's a trade that I can go with

stop.rule: Stop below the moving average or trendline support where trend intensity changes
stop.quote: put your stop on the other side of it where the trend is no longer the same intensity

exits.rule: Trail stop up to breakeven quickly; hold while above key MAs, target 3:1 risk-reward
exits.quote: if I get it right I have my stop I move my stop loss level up to break even as quickly as I can ... I've got a 3:1 risk reward ratio

sizing.rule: Flexible position sizing based on opportunity; keep cash for volatility spikes
sizing.quote: in my trading account I always keep a certain amount of cash there in case there's a a absurd Spike in volatility

market_filter.rule: Only trade bull market trends; adapt to regimes and stay selective
market_filter.quote: be a bull market Trader and buy things that are rallying from the bottom left to the Top Hand right corner of your screen

ambiguities.issue: Mentions intraday trading and day trading setups but emphasizes swing/position holds
ambiguities.assumption: Main method for US stocks is discretionary multi-day pattern trading
